Elias placed the compass beside the letter, poured himself tea, and watched until sunrise, certain that some messages travel farther than ships.","w02":"凌晨四点，城市把喧哗折进深蓝的口袋。便利店的灯还亮着，值班员靠在热柜旁打盹；环卫车缓缓转过街口，水花将霓虹推成流动的碎片。高楼顶端隐在薄雾里，几扇窗透出昏黄的光。第一班地铁尚未进站，站台空得能听见风。江边有人跑步，有人收摊，也有人刚结束漫长的夜班。天色微微发白，早餐铺掀开蒸笼，白气升起，像这座城轻轻的呼吸。","w03":"- Recursion means solving a problem by doing the same steps on a smaller part of it.\n- Think of nested boxes: open one, then repeat until you find the key—that final box tells you when to stop.\n- Then work your way back out; every recursive set of steps needs a stopping point, or it will never finish."}
